0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Raptors host the Bulls, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Toronto a 75% chance to win. Brandon Ingram is out for Toronto while recovering from Achilles surgery, and Chucky Hepburn and Nate Bittle are listed as day-to-day with hamstring and foot issues, both as game-time decisions. Chicago's Nic Claxton is also day-to-day with a hamstring problem, and Toronto won all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
